This page is for contributors inspecting earlier decisions. It is not a setup
guide and is not evidence that every environment has been tested.

For current usage, use [Get started](get-started.html) and the
[function reference](../reference/index.html). For current architectural
responsibilities, read [Architecture](workflow-design.html).

## Read records in their context

- [Architecture review](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/REFACTOR_REVIEW.md)
  records the 0.10 to 0.11 transition. Some findings have since been addressed.
- [Capability assessment](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/MODERN_DATA_STACK.md)
  compares implemented components with platform requirements; it is not an operational certification.
- [Validation record](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)
  describes specific versions and environments. Consult CI for the commit you use.
- [DuckLake usability test](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/DUCKLAKE_USER_TEST.md)
  records an executed local simulation, not an independent human study.
- [Documentation review](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md)
  explains the learning structure and how to verify it.

The [repository documentation index](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/README.md)
separates active operational notes from historical implementation plans.
